#comment: EPIC K — Firecracker micro-VM definition for the Reader-Agent sandbox. Firecracker provides KVM-level isolation (stronger than gVisor) with minimal overhead. Requires a Linux host with KVM support. This file is the VM config; the boot script launches firecracker with it.

boot-source.boot_args: console=ttyS0 reboot=k panic=-1 pci=off nomodules random.trust_cpu=on

network-interfaces.#comment-network: The TAP device connects ONLY to a restricted bridge with a single NAT rule to the LLM endpoint — not to Mongo/engine.
